_about: Hand check (October 2026) of every book the first judge said states the claim, in both runs: does the passage state the claim's fact? 'states' lists the books that do; 'not' records claims the judge passed that do not hold up, and why.

not.Silvae@1345841665#7076: Image caption; the books describe funerary-banquet reliefs in general, not the pictured one. Partial at best.
not.Khirbet Kerak@1368547483#14129: settlements (Cohen): about the Red Sea and Lycian cities named Philotera, not Philoteria in Galilee.
not.Junkers Ju 52@1374490506#15921: Passages say a Ju 52 towed one, or 'two or three', gliders; none says up to two DFS 230s.
not.A-Imdugud@1358747319#1777: Names the seal and tomb, not the cuneiform spelling the tag is on. Partial.
not.Cathedral of Évora@1373206424#3475: A list of Évora teachers with the four names; does not say pupils. Partial.
not.Cenomanian@1362029724#3853: Passages date a deposit to the upper Cenomanian, ~95 Mya; none says the substage starts then. Partial.
not.Spotted corydoras@1355298494#2999: Aquarium encyclopedias' 'Diet: Worms, crustaceans, insects, plant matter' lines, but the passage does not show which species. Unverified.
not.Otter civet@1371730282#2216: carnivores0000reyn and its reprints: the webbed-feet lines may describe other species. Unverified.
not.Didius Julianus@1370266531#1728: The judge's quote ('His reign marks the start of the Empire's decline') is not in the book: GPT-OSS invented it.
not.Nitroxinil@1352698310#3075: 'also active against thiabendazole-resistant Haemonchus contortus': the passage does not show which drug. Unverified.
not.Fort Buford Stage Road@1373286591#872: An 1870 report of roads to Fort Buford, Dakota Territory; not this road. Partial.
